source_text: [1] Ἀδελφοί μου, λίαν ἐκκέχυμαι ἀγαπῶν ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑπεραγαλλόμενος ἀσφαλίζομαι ὑμᾶς: οὐκ ἐγὼ δέ, ἀλλ’ Ἰησοῦς Χριστός, ἐν ᾧ δεδεμένος φοβοῦμαι μᾶλλον, ὡς ἔτι ὢν ἀναπάρτιστος: ἀλλ’ ἡ προσευχὴ ὑμῶν εἰς θεόν με ἀπαρτίσει, ἵνα ἐν ᾧ κλήρῳ ἠλεήθην ἐπιτύχω, προσφυγὼν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ ὡς σαρκὶ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ τοῖς ἀποστόλοις ὡς πρεσβυτερίῳ ἐκκλησίας. [2] καὶ τοὺς προφήτας δὲ ἀγαπῶμεν, διὰ τὸ καὶ αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον κατηγγελκέναι καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἐλπίζειν καὶ αὐτὸν ἀναμένειν, ἐν ᾦ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσώθησαν, ἐν ἑνότητι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὄντες, ἀξιαγαπητοι καὶ ἀξιοθαύμαστοι ἅγιοι, ὑπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεμαρτυρημένοι καὶ συνηριθμημένοι ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τῆς κοινῆς ἐλπίδος.
pass_a_gloss: My brothers, I am poured out in my love for you, and rejoicing greatly I try to make you safe; yet not I, but Jesus Christ, in whom I am bound and fear all the more, as being still incomplete. But your prayer to God will make me complete, so that I may attain the lot in which I have received mercy, having taken refuge in the gospel as in the flesh of Jesus, and in the apostles as in the presbytery of the church. And let us love the prophets too, because they also made their proclamation with the gospel in view, and hoped in him and waited for him; and believing in him they were saved, being in the unity of Jesus Christ, saints worthy of love and of wonder, who have received the witness of Jesus Christ and have been counted together in the gospel of our common hope.
pass_b_english: My brothers, I am poured out, wholly, in my love for you. In my great joy I try to keep you safe. And yet it is not I, but Jesus Christ. I wear these chains in him, and I am all the more afraid, because I am not yet made complete. But your prayer to God will make me complete, so that I may win the lot in which I have been shown mercy. I take refuge in the gospel as in the very flesh of Jesus, and in the apostles as in the church's presbytery.

And let us love the prophets too. Their preaching also pointed to the gospel. They hoped in him and waited for him, and by believing in him they were saved. They stood in the unity of Jesus Christ: saints worthy of love and wonder, approved by the witness of Jesus Christ, and numbered together in the gospel of our shared hope.

choices.english: I am poured out, wholly, in my love for you
choices.why: Perfect passive of ἐκχέω with λίαν; keeps his self-spending image.
rejected: I am greatly enlarged in loving you

choices.english: not yet made complete / make me complete
choices.why: Same root twice; the martyr not yet finished. Paired English keeps the echo.

choices.term: προσφυγὼν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ ὡς σαρκὶ Ἰησοῦ
choices.english: I take refuge in the gospel as in the very flesh of Jesus
choices.why: The gospel is his refuge as if it were Jesus' own flesh; ὡς kept.

choices.english: I wear these chains in him
choices.why: ἐν ᾧ is 'in whom', not 'for whose sake'.

anf_compare.notes: Same sense. ANF 'for whose sake being bound' loosens ἐν ᾧ (in whom); ANF 'greatly enlarged' is weak for ἐκκέχυμαι (poured out); ANF supplies '[us]' after 'reckoned along with'.

notes: Source shows 'ᾦ' for ᾧ and 'ἀξιαγαπητοι' without accent; reproduced as supplied.

review.notes: Source paragraph 1: Greek text matches Ignatius Philadelphians 5 per Lake 1912 Loeb. Pass A and B both render all clauses: ἔκκεχυμαι ἀγαπῶν ὑμᾶς as 'poured out...in my love for you' (A) and 'poured out, wholly, in my love for you' (B); ἀναπάρτιστος as 'still incomplete' (A) and 'not yet made complete' (B); ἀπαρτίσει as 'will make me complete' (both); προσευχὴ ὑμῶν εἰς θεόν as 'your prayer to God' (both); ἐν ᾧ κλήρῳ ἠλεήθην ἐπιτύχω as 'attain the lot in which I have received mercy' (A) and 'win the lot in which I have been shown mercy' (B); προσφυγὼν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ ὡς σαρκὶ Ἰησοῦ as 'having taken refuge in the gospel as in the flesh of Jesus' (A) and 'I take refuge in the gospel as in the very flesh of Jesus' (B); καὶ τοῖς ἀποστόλοις ὡς πρεσβυτερίῳ ἐκκλησίας as 'and in the apostles as in the presbytery of the church' (A) and 'in the apostles as in the church's presbytery' (B); ἀξιαγαπητοι καὶ ἀξιοθαύμαστοι ἅγιοι as 'saints worthy of love and of wonder' (A) and 'saints worthy of love and wonder' (B); ὑπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεμαρτυρημένοι as 'who have received the witness of Jesus Christ' (A) and 'approved by the witness of Jesus Christ' (B); συνηριθμημένοι ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τῆς κοινῆς ἐλπίδος as 'have been counted together in the gospel of our common hope' (A) and 'numbered together in the gospel of our shared hope' (B). No omissions, additions, or contradictions. Negation (οὐκ ἐγὼ δέ, ἀλλ’ Ἰησοῦς Χριστός) preserved as 'yet not I, but Jesus Christ' (A) and 'And yet it is not I, but Jesus Christ' (B). Agency clear. Modality (φοβοῦμαι μᾶλλον) as 'fear all the more' (A) and 'I am all the more afraid' (B). Doctrine of Christ as refuge and unity preserved. Scripture: no explicit citations; apparatus none. Title 'Refuge in the Gospel' names the thought. Notes mention OCR: 'ᾦ' for 'ᾧ' and 'ἀξιαγαπητοι' without accent. All checks pass. Covered source paragraphs: [1].
